title: Juicy Smoked Saudi-Arabian Lamb Kebabs
description: Rich, snappy, and flavorful, these kebabs are the perfect hangover cure featuring parma ham and binchotan-charcoal.

ingredients.name: 4 boneless lamb shoulder chops
ingredients.notes: preferably with a good balance of fat and lean meat

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together olive oil, garlic, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper to create the marinade.
Add the lamb shoulder chops to the marinade and mix well to coat.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat the binchotan charcoal grill to medium-high heat.
Thread the marinated lamb shoulder chops and slices of parma ham onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill the kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the lamb is cooked to your desired level of doneness.
Transfer the kebabs to a plate and sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley.
Let the kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving to allow the juices to redistribute.
Serve with your favorite sides, such as grilled vegetables or a side salad.
